description: Form 8582 income absorption with the MFS zero allowance (mirrors TaxCalcBench ty25-us-009): passive royalty income 2,000 absorbs 2,000 of the 43,636 passive rental loss (SS 469(d)); the SS 469(i) allowance is ZERO because an MFS filer who did not live apart at all times gets none (SS 469(i)(5)(B)) despite active participation. Allowed = 2,000; the QBI base then nets 10,000 - 2,000 = 8,000, the reference return's number. Hand-computed.
